Bounded Mini CLI guardrail release order under Bug wi_5209b017e66bbf20@1, implementation5969, owner6118. Coordinator lead-recovery owns qualified source integration, immutable package preparation and Mini-only installation; actual db-handler owns native source/phase acceptance and work-item records; existing allocation-context-qa-mini owns independent package/installed verification via fresh bounded continuations as necessary. Candidate is ONLY source5209674b61ce5f91d826e34908adf375379c4fe6/tree5064fd0b9abb73c5fe8bbc8eccaca925689e9f76, parent accepted5793de112e1b4c0a08d55fba17a7736e0bf2e0bf. Independent source PASS6101 and original builder result5994 must be linked to the actual native result and handler-saved source acceptance before qualified packaging/install. Preserve known unrelated TestSpawn model/reasoning baseline limitations.

Prepare a clean isolated source checkout and reproducible Darwin/arm64 Mini CLI binary only, retaining exact source/tree, compiler/build flags/VCS metadata, checksums and private immutable package/evidence. No unqualified Queue5928 or cleanup5349 source. Verify binary/source provenance and perform isolated CLI smoke tests with synthetic loopback server/context/identities and private HOME/XDG: valid complete context succeeds with canonical digest and expected frozen identities; Board-only/malformed/mismatched context fails before any allocation HTTP mutation; retry/transport remains correct. Exercise the same candidate binary that will be installed. Obtain independent exact package QA. Preserve source-versus-installed evidence and do not relabel build/create/ack receipts as results.

Before installation freshly pin actual existing Mini ~/.local/bin/tt (expected prior accepted successor/admission binary SHA2c23f9975462afb0bb587d7e213ae6272cae6062e6cf9a09bfba451133b1b378, verify actual bytes) and save an exclusive rollback copy with its original mode. If installed bytes changed, reconcile concrete provenance before overwriting. After handler-saved source/package acceptance, atomically replace only Mini CLI with the exact approved binary, then verify installed hash and clean exact VCS source, rerun required isolated installed-binary guardrail smokes, obtain independent installed QA and handler-saved phase acceptance. Do not overwrite any unrelated change. If installation or smoke fails, report exact state and use preserved prior executable only through the same bounded rollback path; no DB restore or schema rollback.

This CLI-only change shares validator code at source but installs no hub binary or service: existing hub5793de1, frontend TailOS, Air, previews, Tailscale, network and relay process/config remain untouched. No live allocation/Queue fixtures or token output; synthetic identities are test-only against loopback. No intent/history rewrite, existing unused-intent deletion or claim that digest-only allocation API validates context bytes. Keep actual handler/root/operator and useful project teams available. Record concrete immutable package, rollback and installed smoke evidence with this work-order ID; separately saved release acceptance must not imply the larger typed-provenance Bug is Done. Owner6118 explicitly authorizes this bounded development/deployment without another GO; no installation before concrete qualification gates above.
